original_benchmark.notes: 100 deep-research queries with 3,934 weighted expert criteria. Upstream ships the dataset and a grader library (paper-instruments/rubric, LLM judge, Gemini-3-Pro in the paper); responses were produced by deep research APIs and Claude with server-side tools, outside any harness.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity pending: plan to be agreed with the Harbor team. Verifier calls the official grader library with its default judge prompt; reward is the clamped normalized score.
